title: C1: fetch small EvalAwareBench sample (ask first), record schema, scripts/convert_evalawarebench.py -> benchmarks.py JSONL with cue flags, original+minimal-cue, frozen 60/40 split
summary: 9202e5f: scripts/convert_evalawarebench.py --fetch (aisa-group/EvalAwareBench@ee984a8, public, CC BY-NC 4.0; HF configs are tasks/prompts/prompts_safety/prompts_capability, no 'default' -> the old 404). original=nfv8 (all 8 cues on), minimal_cue=nfv0; ids = task_id in both files; cue flags/label/config in meta; cue_pairs.jsonl for calibrate. 200 items per config (100 safety/100 capability), 0 failed, 0 multi-turn (39 original prompts embed User:/Human: lines = F6 cue). Prompts gitignored; frozen split data/benchmarks/evalawarebench_split.json (128 dev/72 held, grouped by task pair). benchmarks.load_items_with_meta/freeze_split/load_split/apply_split. tests/test_benchmarks.py. Facts in data/benchmarks/README.md
